system.description: Binder Cuffs are Durasteel restraints designed to lock two limbs of a prisoner together, normally the wrists or ankles, but it is possible to lock one arm to one leg or use the Binder Cuffs to hook a prisoner to a tree. The cuffs have a Damage Reduction score of 10, 20 hit points, and a Strength score of 40. Breaking them requires a DC 30 Strength check, and removing them without the seven-digit release code requires a DC 25 Mechanics check. The Binder Cuffs can be attached to the limbs of any creature of Large, Medium, or Small size.
